name: zxkit
//overrides: One React across the workspace. Without this, a package adding react as a devDependency creates a second peer-resolution bucket and duplicates react-hook-form between @zxkit/ui and @zxkit/surface, whose types then stop matching in apps/web. Next is here for the same reason: @zxkit/authz takes it as a range and apps/web pins it exactly, which resolves to two copies. The @types entries belong here rather than in apps/web, because an override declared in a workspace child is exactly what creates that second bucket.
